She has her eyes closed and a contented smile. Behind her, a vast urban landscape with green fields and distant buildings stretches under a cloudy, overcast gray sky. Yellow and white text overlays appear momentarily at the center of the frame. (2) The scene shifts to a bright indoor setting, likely a home office or living area. The woman sits at a wooden table equipped with a silver laptop and a smartphone. She is eating from a brown paper takeaway bowl with chopsticks, appearing rushed as she glances between her food and the laptop screen. Her expression shifts to visible distress as she puts down her chopsticks and clutches her stomach, looking uncomfortable. The lighting is bright and even. (3) Transitioning to the solution, she smiles again and holds up a brown glass bottle of Kombucha tea to the camera. She points her index finger upward in an 'aha' gesture. She is then seen drinking from the bottle while sitting at the same wooden desk. The final segment shows her giving a thumbs-up gesture and ends with a product lineup shot featuring two glass bottles and four aluminum cans of different colors arranged on a low table in a living room with a gray sofa.
